item.title: Narrow Entryway Organization: Build a Drop Zone That Stays Tidy
item.description: Why Narrow Entryways Become Cluttered So Quickly A narrow entryway has a difficult job: it is both a passage and a landing place. The moment you walk through the door, you need somewhere to put keys, shoes, bags, mail, jackets, and the small things you were carrying. If there is no clear destination for those items, they naturally collect on the nearest surface or floor. The solution is not to squeeze more furniture into the hallway.
